CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to content organization present.

COD.rationale: Content (red coordinates), its presented organization (coordinate set) and a separate origin/status field are all explicitly given for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-change claim linked to a named content's organization/access.

C.rationale: Multiple lines identify specific content items (color-labeled sets of coordinates) with explicit referents and attributes.

D.rationale: Origin/status fields (kind/record_time/represented_time) are provided separately from the coordinate content, attributing status to the contents.

O.rationale: The report explicitly states how contents are presented as organized sets of coordinates for each color and referent.
